title: 入口专题 C1：撤掉 ask_ai 动作类型（enumWithRetiredValues、ADR-0087 三项、只为它存在的导出），19.0 正式版前
body:
epic:#5027#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMUfmNYTem26rXLFUf

Filing gate: ④ topic child. Source: topic #37853 (Jack: 「"页面里加按钮"的需求 作废」 06:28Z; card 「撤掉 ask_ai」 06:30Z; 「问 AI」 06:33Z; 「同意，立专题卡，非 cloud 的任务，让 objectstack #3 座位接手」 07:12Z, all 2026-11-27). Business reason: carried by the parent.
Parent: objectstack-ai/objectstack#37853 (rulings, target experience, card table, topic acceptance). Evidence: an independent Fable review of objectstack and cloud `main` (2026-11-27) checked every file:line below.
Owner: **repo:objectstack#3** (Jack 07:12Z 「非 cloud 的任务，让 objectstack #3 座位接手」). Reserved under topic #37853 (`pm:epic`), not `pm:queue`: other seats leave it.

Grading: area:ai · Task · p1 · size L · window: before 19.0.0 GA (the action type shipped in 18.x; removal is a breaking change).
Blocked-by: C0a (#37854) (the amendment fixes the legacy-metadata behaviour).
Dedupe: searched `ask_ai`: #37142 (closed, introduced it), #37827 (open bug: record page hides `ask_ai`) is closed by this card; #37834 is the decision.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：删掉 `ask_ai` 动作类型，以及只为它存在的代码和导出；旧元数据按 C0a (#37854) 的处方报错或跳过。
- 影响：列表每行直接问 AI 没了（Jack 06:30 已接受）；brightrule 已装的那个动作要先处理。
- 要你做什么：无（发版前要发布负责人一句话，见下文 changeset 那条）。

## Background (verified)
- `ask_ai` is a value of `ActionType` (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:706`). The real reference surface is 60 files; a regex finds 63, of which **3 must stay**: Studio canvas 「问 AI 生成字段」 (`ObjectFormCanvas.tsx`, `studio/{en,zh}.ts`).
- Exports that exist only for it: `setChatFocus`, `ActionRunner.setAssistantFocusHandler`, `onAskAi`, `surfaceAgent.ts` `catalogServesFocus` / `focusAgentName`, `dashboard.zod.ts` `refuseRecordlessAskAi`. cloud mentions it only in comments; hotcrm has none.
- `content/docs/references/**` is generated: run `gen:docs`, do not hand-edit.
- `setChatFocus`, the pin control, 「改为问」 and `console.ai.focus.*` strings have only shipped in prereleases (`.changeset/pre/36999-conversation-focus.md`, app-shell `18.6.0-next.0`).

## What to do
1. `ActionType` → `enumWithRetiredValues()` with the prescription (precedent `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts:161,173`). ADR-0087's three duties: conversion in `conversions/entries/19/`, a D3 semantic entry, the disposition marker in the changeset. The four generated baselines do not change for "one enum value fewer": expected, not missed.
2. Implement the legacy behaviour exactly as C0a (#37854) writes it (source refusal with prescription; conversion auto-deletes only without references; installed metadata per C0a (#37854)).
3. Remove the runtime and ui paths and the exports above; regenerate the API surface (`gen:api-surface`). spec and `ui/` changes go in **one PR** (release checklist item 4 in `AGENTS.md`).
4. Examples: remove `ask_ai` actions and the page references to them (e.g. showcase `task-detail.page.ts`).
5. Not in this card: `skills/**` (C1s) and ADRs (C0a (#37854)).
6. `.changeset/pre/` holds two consumed changesets that describe the pin / `ask_ai`; ask the release owner whether their text may change. If not, put the correction in this card's changeset.
7. Close #37827 with this PR.

## brightrule (outside the fleet board; the C1 owner coordinates it before C1 releases)
- brightrule's installed metadata has one action `brightrule_policy_ask`, `locations: ['record_header','list_item']`; no declaration was found in its `src/` (it depends on spec 18.6.0); `docs/policy-admin.md:76` mentions it.
- Before C1 releases: find where it is declared, delete it, fix `docs/policy-admin.md:76`, and handle the copy installed in deployed environments. Ask the maintainer who owns brightrule if unsure.

## Acceptance
- Parsing a source file with `type:'ask_ai'` fails with the prescription text; `os migrate meta --from 18` lists it; installed metadata behaves as C0a (#37854) says.
- Zero change in the four generated baselines; `git grep -n ask_ai` leaves only the prescription line, the conversion entry, the changeset, and the 3 Studio canvas hits.
- Studio's 「问 AI 生成字段」 still works; brightrule boots on the new version.
